run_posetrack17_baseline_experiment: run the posetrack17 baseline training and inference experiment with a given number of labeled videos and frames
run_posetrack17_posewarper_experiment: run the posetrack17 PoseWarper training and inference experiment with temporal pose aggregation
run_posetrack17_video_pose_propagation: run the video pose propagation experiment using PoseWarper across sparsely labeled videos
run_posetrack17_data_augmentation: run the data augmentation experiment using PoseWarper propagated poses as pseudo ground truth
run_posetrack17_sot_experiment: run the state-of-the-art experiment using the full PoseTrack17 dataset
